aa-reference-2026-11.title: A&A reference configurations (November 2026)
aa-reference-2026-11.summary: Published A&A configurations rerun with corrected CODES. The four original architectures were trained with three independent seeds and five ensemble members per seed, using the archived hyperparameters.
aa-reference-2026-11.timing: Synchronized forward calls after one warm-up pass. Each run's total forward-call time is divided by validation trajectories × stored timesteps. The protocol uses model-specific batch sizes.
aa-reference-2026-11.rollout: Ordinary training · stored time grid · 10 stored steps per chunk

notes.cloud: FullyConnected seed 142 diverged during repeated prediction (132.386 dex). All three FullyConnected seeds also overflowed the real-space rollout error summaries. The log-space results remain visible.
notes.primordial_parametric: MultiONet seed 42 diverged during repeated prediction (6.563 dex). Real-space rollout error summaries overflowed for this run and for FullyConnected seed 142.
notes.cloud_parametric: The training split was subsampled by a factor of two. Evaluation used the full validation split. All three MultiONet seeds overflowed the real-space rollout error summaries.
